name: calculate-birth-charts
description: Deterministically calculate Western natal charts, Four Pillars/BaZi, Zi Wei Dou Shu, and bounded Vedic/Jyotish charts. Vedic output reports both node modes without a product default; its high-precision statement is limited to the documented Swiss-only external numeric-reference fixture. All math is done by a bundled offline CLI; the model never computes charts.
